title: Cosmic Portal Selfie
description: A woman in pink and black armor with a checkered cape sits on a bed of pink pillows taking a selfie with her smartphone while making a peace sign. To her left, a kneeling armored figure interacts with two glowing circular magical portals emitting pink energy beams toward a large striped gothic cathedral under a vibrant cosmic nebula sky.
prompt: A woman in shiny pink segmented armor with black accents and a black-and-white checkered cape sits on a pile of pink patterned pillows taking a selfie with her pink smartphone while making a peace sign. Beside her, a kneeling armored character reaches toward two large glowing circular magical portals with intricate designs that emit bright pink energy beams. In the background stands a massive striped gothic cathedral under a dramatic pink, purple and blue cosmic nebula sky filled with stars and silhouettes, surreal fantasy scene.
